'''Greel's speeder shop''' was a [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]] shop located in [[Ardak Point]], the main settlement on [[Kessan's Landing]], an island on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]]. During the [[Third Galactic War]], the shop was used as a front for the [[Republic Strategic Information Service]].<ref name="TOR:AFoT" />
